pages.text: Boss materials are unique crafting components dropped only by specific bosses. They are used in:$(br2)$(li)Waystone construction (expensive by design)$(li)Class Altar construction$(li)Tier 4 advanced recipes$(li)Mythic infusion (endgame)$(br2)Unlike progression tokens, boss materials are $(italic)spoils$() — not currency — and are not interchangeable between bosses. Each boss's material has specific uses.

pages.title: T2 Boss Materials
pages.text: $(bold)Naga Scale$() — Twilight Forest Naga. Used in Tier 2 armor crafting recipes.$(br2)$(bold)Lich Soul$() — Lich. Used in necromantic recipes, Occultism preparations.$(br2)$(bold)Hydra Fang$() — Hydra. Used in melee weapon enhancement recipes.$(br2)$(bold)Ur-Ghast Tear$() — Ur-Ghast. Used in aerial mobility items.

pages.title: T3 Boss Materials
pages.text: $(bold)Harbinger Eye$() — Cataclysm: The Harbinger. High-value T3 crafting material.$(br2)$(bold)Ignis Core$() — Cataclysm: Ignis. Used in fire-themed T3+ recipes.$(br2)$(bold)Nether Soul Fragment$() — Wither Skeletons (rare). Used in Stalwart Dungeons preps.$(br2)$(bold)Gaia Spirit Fragment$() — Botania Gaia Guardian. Required for Mahou Tsukai initiation.

pages.title: T4 Boss Materials
pages.text: $(bold)Dragon Heart$() — Ender Dragon. Used in ultimate crafting recipes, Mythic infusion base.$(br2)$(bold)Dragon Scale$() — Ender Dragon. Used in Tier 4 armor crafting.$(br2)$(bold)Void Essence$() — Rare Enderman drop. Used in Void Summoner builds.$(br2)$(bold)Wither Bone$() — Wither. Used in Stalwart Dungeons and necromantic recipes.
